note: PROPANE has no in-game production path at all - unlike wood (harvested from trees via logging), propane only ever enters play by the player acquiring it externally (buying/hauling it in, mechanism TBD elsewhere), then storing it in a tank/container and drawing it down. Do not add a propane producer/refiner/well item or mechanic - propane is purely a consumable resource that depletes.
title: Fuel

capacity_l.note: liters held/stored; 0 for dispensing pumps (they draw from a separate tank, not a store themselves); firewood uses volume-equivalent liters

burn_minutes_per_item.note: IN-GAME minutes (40 real minutes = 1 full in-game day = 1440 in-game minutes at 1x speed; using in-game time keeps consumption correct when the player speeds up time). How many in-game minutes one inventory unit of this item burns for when used as fuel (solid fuels: wood, charcoal). 0 for liquid/gas fuels and dispensing pumps, which are consumed continuously by rate/tank level instead of per discrete item.
